title: Juicy Light Uruguayan Fish Ceviche
description: A refreshing and light Uruguayan dish featuring fish marinated in a zesty mixture, with a unique use of bicarbonate of soda to enhance the texture, air-fried for a crispy touch, and served in a ramekin, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for any occasion, with its umami flavor and festive presentation.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the bicarbonate of soda with the lime juice in a small bowl.
Add the fish pieces to the bowl and marinate for 10 minutes.
Remove the fish from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish and season with salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Air-fry the fish for 5 minutes or until cooked through.
Mix the chopped onion and cilantro in a small bowl.
Serve the fish in a ramekin with the onion and cilantro mixture on top.
Drizzle any remaining lime juice over the top and serve immediately.
